{{Unknown name}} A group of nameless {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who participate in the [[Battle Royal]] have made minor recurring appearances in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. They first appeared in ''[[SM063|Pushing the Fiery Envelope!]]'' and later made another appearance in ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]''. ==Primarina Trainer== [[File:Battle Royal Primarina Trainer.png|thumb|250px|The Primarina Trainer]] This female Trainer first appeared in ''[[SM063|Pushing the Fiery Envelope!]]''. She battled {{an|Professor Kukui|the Masked Royal}} and two other Trainers in a [[Battle Royal]], but lost to the Masked Royal when he used his {{TP|Professor Kukui|Incineroar}}'s [[Z-Move]] {{m|Malicious Moonsault}} to defeat all of its three opponents. She appeared again in ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', where she participated in another Battle Royal against the {{p|Decidueye}} Trainer, the {{p|Machamp}} Trainer, and one of the [[Revengers]] with his {{p|Poliwrath}}. The outcome of the battle is unknown. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Trainer |pkmn=Primarina |width=68 |type1=Water |type2=Fairy |img=Battle Royal Trainer Primarina.png |epnum=SM063 |epname=Pushing the Fiery Envelope! |vaen=Laurie Hymes |desc=This Trainer's {{p|Primarina}} appeared in ''[[SM063|Pushing the Fiery Envelope!]]'', where it participated in a Battle Royal against a {{p|Machamp}}, a {{p|Decidueye}}, and {{an|Professor Kukui|the Masked Royal}}'s {{TP|Professor Kukui|Incineroar}}. It attacked Incineroar with {{m|Sparkling Aria}}, but it was eventually defeated when Incineroar used the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Malicious Moonsault}}. It appeared again in ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', where it fought alongside its Trainer in another Battle Royal against Machamp, Decidueye, and a [[Revengers]]' {{p|Poliwrath}}. Primarina's only known move is {{m|Sparkling Aria}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{water color light}}|bordercolor={{fairy color dark}} |ja= |en=[[Kate Bristol]] ([[SM063]])
